content.coverageNote: Complete substantive exchange and closing promotion are covered. participants.basis: The complete transcript was reviewed. Curt Jaimungal introduces and clarifies, requests definitions, summarizes the speakers for correction, asks what could change their beliefs, and asks Blackmore about named researchers without endorsing their conclusions. These are facilitative prompts, not independent advocacy. The potentially substantive error-bar question at 1:19:21 is audio-attributed to Kastrup, not the host.

format.offMotionCoverage: Complete substantive conversation from the opening illusionism explanation to the final belief-revision answer; introductory promotion, the duplicated opening teaser, host logistics and closing promotion are not scored. No later substantive debate is omitted.

positionCaution: Blackmore explicitly rejects materialism at about 19:41 and does not offer a complete rival metaphysics. Assess her actual illusionist and explanatory objections, not an invented duty to defend physicalism or deny all phenomenal experience.

relatedRecordingComparison.conclusion: Different recording and conversation, not an alternative upload or excerpt of the existing debate.
